ov: العروسة الهاربة (الإنجليزية: Runaway Bride) هو فيلم كوميدي رومانسي أمريكي من إخراج غاري مارشال وبطولة جوليا روبرتس، ريتشارد جير، جوان كوزاك، هيكتور أليزوندو، ريتا ويلسون وبول دولي، صدر الفيلم في 30 يوليو 1999.
plotEn:
Spirited Maggie Carpenter has left three fiancés at the altar on their wedding day, earning local notoriety and the nickname "the Runaway Bride". Misanthropic New York City columnist Ike Graham writes an unflattering article about Maggie after hearing her story from a man he fails to realize is one of her bitter ex-fiancés. Ike's story is riddled with errors causing Maggie to send a scathing rebuttal to the newspaper, which ultimately results in Ike being fired.
However, his boss offers him another chance by writing an in-depth, truthful article about Maggie, if only to prove she actually is a heartless "man-eater". He travels to Hale, Maryland, where Maggie works at her family's hardware store and also makes designer lamps from spare industrial parts. Her fourth groom-to-be is high school football coach Bob Kelly. Bob is very much into sports psychology, constantly asking Maggie to "visualize" their upcoming wedding.
Ike follows Maggie around town and interviews her friends, family, and former fiancés. Annoyed by his intrusive questioning of those around her, she allows him one-on-one time with her to prove she is a good person. During this period, Ike and Maggie grow closer, using each other's insights to better understand themselves.
